title: Kremlin declines comment on reports 700,000 Russian soldiers killed in Ukraine war
summary: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov on Wednesday declined to comment on reports in Russian and international news outlets that around 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed in the Ukraine war so far.
